advisory_text: MLflow model serving 命令注入漏洞 CVE-2026-0596 - mlserver.py
advisory_text_note: Shared text derives from advisory_pairs_v5 vulnerability_title, with the editorial enable_mlserver=True annotation omitted. It is a dataset advisory summary, not the original advisory body. Only the entry code marker and this summary are supplied as editorial context to both conditions. The critical operation marker is omitted; source code within the entry remains available. B measures scenario discovery with advisory hints, not repository-only held-out discovery.

input_parameter.rationale: The bounded scenario assumes a caller can create and supply an existing local directory path; remote reachability is not established.

enable_mlserver.rationale: The serving caller selects the MLServer backend.

sys.platform.startswith('linux').rationale: The bounded execution environment runs on Linux.

is_windows().rationale: The process follows the non-Windows platform branch.

self._env_manager != em.LOCAL.rationale: The backend uses the local environment manager.

os.path.exists(artifact_uri).rationale: The supplied local artifact directory exists before the serving call.

port.rationale: The serving endpoint has a concrete port.

host.rationale: The serving endpoint binds to a concrete host.

timeout.rationale: The serving caller leaves the request timeout unset.

self._nworkers.rationale: The backend is constructed with one worker.

model_config.rationale: The serving call supplies no model configuration override.

synchronous.rationale: The serving caller requests asynchronous startup.

MLServerDefaultModelName.rationale: The loaded MLServer integration supplies this default model name.
